description: A unit of state created with `atom(initialValue)`. It is a config object; its value lives in a store.
`atom((get) => ...)` computes a value from other atoms and updates when they change.
`atom(read, (get, set, ...args) => ...)` can be written to and updates other atoms.
`atom(null, write)` models an action that updates one or more atoms.
Returns only the setter, so the component does not subscribe to the atom's value.
`<Provider>` scopes atom values to a subtree. `createStore()` creates a store you can `get`, `set` and `sub` outside React.
